Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015). ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

- **Fresh read on objectui `main` `8392f74afe`:**
  - `deriveMasterDetail.ts:113`–`:114` still hydrates a boolean / toggle child into `Yes` / `No` options;
  - `GridField.tsx:510` / `:512` still print `${n} files` / `'File'`.
- **Why p1 + `target:v18`:** the PDF chain (「PDF 要赶 18.0 正式版」). Since PR #12923 (objectui#12915), a read-only line-items table prints through `displayText` on screen and on paper. So a non-English printed document with a boolean or multi-file line column reads English cell values. This is the same grade this seat gave the line-items headings (objectstack-ai/objectstack#24140).
- **Scope = the card's Expected:**
  - the boolean options read existing yes / no keys where one fits (the objectui#11689 precedent);
  - the file text reads a counted key with its plural family in every pack;
  - a pin renders each under zh-CN.
  - ⛔ The stored values `'true'` / `'false'` are unchanged: display only.
- **Lane:** `domain:ui` (`packages/plugin-form`, `packages/fields`).

The first write read `yes (widening)` on the premise of a new key. A narrowing owes one `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` review before the queue.
